material_tradeoff: Exported scripts become readable source text. Package size and load behavior may differ from compressed token export; no performance improvement is inferred from source review.

acceptance.reason: This verdict approves source correctness and scope only. A fresh current-main release still needs pack identity and artifact hashes, actual fresh Stormwood geometry/scatter, required affected checks, and two Medium plus two High release route measurements with debug false, fresh user data, 15-second warmup, at least 60-second measurement, and no missing/stale/SCRIPT ERROR failures. Performance thresholds remain >=60 FPS and P99 <=33ms where applicable; old pack evidence cannot satisfy them.

review_constraints: No repository edits, native Godot jobs, imports, exports, cache mutation, task creation/archive, or app-thread messaging performed. Only temporary review artifacts were written; existing proof artifacts retained.
